description: Coerce a victim and relay its NTLM to the ADCS web enrollment endpoint to obtain a certificate (ESC8).

telemetry.detail: Authentication coercion (PetitPotam MS-EFSR, PrinterBug MS-RPRN, DFSCoerce, etc.) generates distinctive RPC traffic to the victim.
Relayed NTLM authentication lands as a logon on the relay target.
Coercion-plus-relay chains are heavily signatured; NTLM relay is a well-known, widely detected pattern.
Certificate request logged on the CA.
PKINIT TGT request with the issued certificate.

prerequisite_privilege: Network position to coerce and relay; a vulnerable HTTP enrollment endpoint
abuse_primitive: PetitPotam + ntlmrelayx --adcs to /certsrv, obtain a machine/DA-capable cert.
notes: Loudest of the relay family: coercion RPC + relayed logon + CA issuance all fire.
